📖 How this report works

What it shows

What each vendor has delivered against purchase orders, part by part: how long the receipts took after the PO was issued (Lead Time), how much came in (Qty, in the part's UOM), the vendor's last cost for the part and on how many POs it came. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Fulfillment History and reads the same data the same way.

Which receipts

Received purchase and misc. purchase lines on POs with a ticked status: Fulfilled only to start with, as the standard report. Tick Partial or Closed Short to add those POs.

Lead Time averages the whole days from the PO's issue date to each receipt. Unit Cost is the vendor part's last cost in the vendor's currency (a foreign currency shows its code; "/ UOM" when it is for another UOM than the part's). A † on Qty marks receipts in a UOM that can't be converted to the part's: they are left out, and the mark says how much.

Using it
  • Filter changes apply straight away. Choosing no vendors, classes or location groups means all of them. Received narrows the receipts to a date range.
  • Group by groups the vendors by the PO line's class or the PO's location group; Sort parts by orders the parts by number or description.
  • More columns adds the receipt count, the shortest and longest lead time, the last receipt date and the vendor's part number.
  • Click a group's row to show or hide its vendors and parts; Expand / Collapse do every group. Click a vendor or part to open it in Fishbowl.
  • Opened from the Vendor module, the report starts on that vendor; change the Vendors filter to see others.
  • Click a column heading to sort the parts within each vendor (again to reverse, a third time for the standard order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • The Table / Pivot selector switches to a pivot: the average lead time, the qty, the number of receipts, POs or parts by any two of vendor, part, PO, class, location group, UOM, date received and date issued. It opens on the average lead time by vendor and quarter received. Qty adds parts' own UOMs, so total it per part. Click a figure to see the receipts behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 or so receipt lines (whole vendors) with a Load all button; the rows then cover the receipts shown.
